'''Game Go''' was an establishment located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated next to [[Admiral Snackbar/Legends|Admiral Snackbar]], close to the diner [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]].
